newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 7.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- West African rice research institute says farmers could soon have improved African rice variety with potential for between 20 and 40 percent higher yield.
- Three years after devaluation of CFA franc, result generally positive.
- Privatisation of cotton sector in Francophone African states despite brilliant performance of industry viewed by French expert group as dangerous for peasant producers.
- Slowly, Africa gets connected on the Internet.
